summary: Corvex, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing an At-the-Market Sales Agreement with Chardan Capital Markets LLC as sales agent, under which the company may offer and sell common stock from time to time via an at-the-market offering under Rule 415(a)(4). No share amount, price, or dollar capacity is stated. Chardan receives a 2.5% commission on gross proceeds plus expense reimbursements capped at $75,000 initially, $10,000 quarterly, and $30,000 per program refresh. Net proceeds are for working capital and general corporate purposes. Shares sell under an effective Form S-3 shelf declared September 16, 2026. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and any principal sales under separate terms agreements.
